A FEW USEFUL ANSWERS

Before you
jump in.

Who is this AI course for?

People who know about AI tools and want to become better at using them for everyday tasks, learning, creating, and problem-solving.

What will I learn?

Prompting, context, iteration, research and verification, creative work, coding with AI, and building your own repeatable workflow.

How is the course structured?

The course has seven practical lessons, exercises, short quizzes, and reusable prompt patterns. Plan for 30–45 minutes per learning session.

How do I register?

Complete the registration form above and submit it. You can also open the same Google Form in a separate tab.

Where can I see the course workbook?

Open the existing course workbook ↗
